BL-968 — BL-761 acceptance-contract gate is blind on effectively every send: three step files run git rev-parse at module load, so the materialized non-repo registry tree never loads and the gate warns-and-skips - make the registry loadable from a materialized tree and guard that property
What it solves: Source: documenter priority-10 note 20260820T000811Z_000218 to specifier+coordinator ("BL-761 acceptance gate fails OPEN 2/2 sends: git rev-parse outside a repo"), per Article 4.4's spec-gap-leaves-by-note posture. 1:1 - the note produced this ticket and no other. Specifier probe went from the note…
Approval context: One deliberate non-change to confirm: the gate KEEPS warn-do-not-block for registry-load failures. Flipping it to fail-closed would have frozen every pipeline send on this very defect for however long the blind window turns out to be; the standing guard instead catches the class at the offending pa…
BL-968 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-968" (or "reject BL-968 <reason>") to act.
